facts.text: Born: 18 November 1910, Burdwan, Bengal; died 20 July 1965
facts.head: Profile

facts.text: Central Assembly Bombing: 8 April 1929 with Bhagat Singh — slogans "Inquilab Zindabad", "Down with Imperialism"; ⚠ bombs harmless / symbolic, not to kill
facts.head: Profile

facts.text: Convicted: Delhi Assembly Bomb Case, 12 June 1929
facts.head: Profile

facts.text: Jails: Multan, Jhelum, Trichinopoly, Salem, Andamans — 9 years
facts.head: Profile

facts.text: In Salem Jail when Bhagat Singh, Rajguru, Sukhdev were hanged (23 March 1931)
facts.head: Profile

facts.text: Released 1938; re-arrested in Quit India (1942) — 4 more years
facts.head: Profile

facts.text: Organisations: HSRA, Naujawan Bharat Sabha; met Bhagat Singh in Kanpur
facts.head: Profile

facts.text: Later life: settled in Patna; six-month nomination to Bihar Legislative Council; bone cancer — AIIMS
facts.head: Profile

facts.text: Cremated: Hussainiwala, beside Bhagat Singh, Rajguru, Sukhdev
facts.head: Profile

facts.text: Book: Bhagat Singh aur Dutt ki Amar Kahani (1966); Author: Chaman Lal Azad
facts.head: Books

facts.text: Book: Bhagat Singh ke Sahyogi: Batukeshwar Dutt; Author: Justice Anil Verma
facts.head: Books

facts.text: Book: Viplvi Batukeshwar Dutt; Author: Bhairav Lal Das
facts.head: Books

facts.text: Film he approved: Manoj Kumar's Shaheed (1965)
facts.head: Books
